<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：北の峠</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分のＡＴ－ＡＴはここに移動する際フォースを消費しない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-North-Ridge-4th-Marker-Dark-SWCA-100674.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark).

'''Dark Side:'''
Your AT-ATs do not spend Force when moving here.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 北の峠, with 第４マーカー as a separate marker label.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
